name: Yoru no Rojiura Annai
source: On Christmas Eve, a girl got lost in an alley. Her only guide is a homeless dog. Help her go through all the circles of hell to get to the main street. But remember that in the alley, everything is not what it seems at first glance!
translation: 平安夜，一个女孩在小巷里迷路了。她唯一的向导是一只无家可归的狗。帮助她穿过地狱的各个圈子到达大街。但请记住，在巷子里，一切都不是乍看起来的那样！
